title: dubuukuy gubal alla tan caxaaxuwi
intro: taswiir tibba le widirih buxâ marih ummattak allal, diini qaadik yan amri elle yangooroweenimi. dubuk yan taama abeyni saytunaane kee amaanat yawqeh, ambulle sinni xayyos sarrimaane le. ta roocih dariifal qaadik tan baxxaqsa sadah tan astooti gaaboysaah, shakki tutuctot qammaltam aracak darrel. xayyow maaqatta kee ankacis, akkel tan numma kulli akkaloylal gexkalootu le.
clues: Anu inni qibaadah inni qibaadah, yi Rabbih rizqih sarrimaanele.
Anu Yalli baadal tan barraak daga yoo doorem ruffa yoo hayta.
Anu ayro mawqah aracak yewqeh, yi ummattak reebimeh, rooci qigduk yan numih weelol yoo yumbulle wak.
Anu num yoo xage weem takkay immay Yallih qangarat baxa soolise.
Anu caxaaxuwi caxak gubal dubuk taama coolaysiteh, gubal yan weeqaytu kee qusba ayroorah akmiyya kee maqab yoo ruffa hayta xongolo obbe.
Anu inni ummattah fanah uduureeh, inni qusba yooboke quukak, tibba exceh, inni alqi Yallih taama abeena akkuk yoo kalaluh qarkayto fanah yaabe.
